# Vendored frontend assets

These static files are vendored to avoid runtime dependency on third-party CDNs. This prevents browser Tracking Prevention / privacy controls from blocking Bootstrap, Bootstrap Icons, or vis-network and breaking the Citadel UI.

| Package | Version | Source | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Bootstrap | 5.3.0 | `bootstrap@5.3.0/dist` | MIT; see `bootstrap/5.3.0/LICENSE` |
| Bootstrap Icons | 1.11.0 | `bootstrap-icons@1.11.0/font` | MIT; see `bootstrap-icons/1.11.0/LICENSE` |
| vis-network | 9.1.9 | `vis-network@9.1.9/standalone/umd` | MIT; see `vis-network/9.1.9/LICENSE` |
